title: 第25章 杀刘傲的计划第26章 了结一切
slug: 绑定全国每人每天给我一两银
lines: 刘傲的营帐里。
柳仙儿躺在那里，衣衫完整，神情祥和，似乎只是睡了过去。
陆舟的脚步顿了一瞬。
那一瞬间，他的喉结剧烈地滚动了一下，握剑的手青筋暴起。
“王爷，末将说了……”
刘傲大步走来，正打算借题发挥讥讽一下对方。
但当看到那床上女子后，身体一僵，犹遭雷击，愣在了原地。
什么情况？！
马六不是已经将人送走了，怎么会还在这里？！
此刻，他的内心涌现出无数困惑。
陆舟冷冷道：“刘傲，你还有什么话可说？”
刘傲回过神来，连忙嚷声道：“王爷！这分明是有人栽赃陷害！”
打赌输了，那自己就要接受对方处置了。
这是绝对不行的！
所以他直接选择了一手耍赖，指着床榻上的柳仙儿，一副被冤枉的表情：“末将与她无冤无仇，掳她来做什么？定是那些流民心怀不轨，偷了人想往末将头上扣屎盆子！”
这番话，听起来有理有据。
但落在陆舟眼里，要多讽刺有多讽刺。
这家伙，没想到脸皮竟然也这般厚。
他冷哼一声。
平静的双眸，透着淡淡的嘲弄，藏着一丝锋锐之气。
刘傲被看得心里发毛，声调也不由提高起来：“王爷若不信，大可将人带走，本将军身正不怕影子斜！”
“但王爷若想借此找事，那我必须得回禀六皇子了！”
他搬出了六皇子，想要震慑对方。
“呵。”陆舟冷笑一声，收回目光，一步一步走向床榻。
看着安静的侍女，他俯身将其抱起，转身朝帐帘走去。
经过刘傲身边时，他停了一步。
“人我带走了。”声音很轻，似乎没有任何愤怒。
因为陆舟很情况，就算对方输了，自己也暂时没办法处置他。
不过不急，这件事后，对方已经活不过明天！
他一定会杀了对方！
刘傲一愣。
他原以为对方会借题发挥，大闹一场。
但此刻的平静，竟是与先前判若两人。
content_en:
In Liu Ao's tent.
Liu Xian'er was lying there, her clothes intact and her expression peaceful, as if she had just fallen asleep.
Lu Zhou paused for a moment.
At that moment, his Adam's apple rolled violently, and veins popped out in the hand holding the sword.
"Your Majesty, the general said..."
Liu Ao strode over, planning to use the topic to ridicule the other party.
But when he saw the woman on the bed, his body stiffened, as if he had been struck by lightning, and he froze in place.
What's going on? !
If Ma Liu had not already sent the person away, how could he still be here? !
At this moment, countless confusions emerged in his heart.
Lu Zhou said coldly: "Liu Ao, what else do you have to say?"
Liu Ao came back to his senses and shouted quickly: "Your Majesty! This is clearly framed!"
If you lose the bet, you will have to accept the other party's disposal.
This is absolutely not possible!
So he directly chose to cheat, pointing at Liu Xian'er on the bed, with an expression of being wronged: "The general has no grievances against her, so why did he kidnap her? Those refugees must have evil intentions. They stole someone and wanted to put a basin of feces on the general's head!"
These words sound reasonable and well-founded.
But in Lu Zhou's eyes, he was as sarcastic as he wanted.
I didn't expect this guy to be so thick-skinned.
He snorted coldly.
His calm eyes showed a touch of mockery, hiding a hint of sharpness.
Liu Ao was so frightened by the sight that he couldn't help but raise his voice: "If the prince doesn't believe it, you can take him away. I, the general, am not afraid of slanting shadows!"
"But if the prince wants to use this to cause trouble, then I must report it back to the sixth prince!"
He moved out the Sixth Prince, hoping to shock the other party.
"Ha." Lu Zhou sneered, looked away, and walked towards the bed step by step.
Looking at the quiet maid, he leaned over to pick her up, turned and walked towards the curtain.
When passing Liu Ao, he stopped for a step.
"I took the person away." The voice was very soft, and there didn't seem to be any anger.
Because Lu Zhou was in a bad situation, even if the opponent lost, he would not be able to deal with him for the time being.
But don't worry, after this incident, the other party will not survive tomorrow!
He will definitely kill the other party!
Liu Ao was stunned.
He originally thought that the other party would use the topic to make a big fuss.
But the calmness at this moment was actually completely different from before.
title_en: Chapter 25 The plan to kill Liu Ao Chapter 26 Ending everything
